facts.text: In June 2003, Constellation Software acquired Gary Jonas Computing Ltd., resulting in the formation of the Jonas Software operating group and its first two brands: Jonas Club Software and Jonas Construction Software.
facts.source_title: 20 Years of Jonas Software Operating Group - Jonas Software

facts.text: Jonas Software is an operating group of Constellation Software, Inc. (CSI), a public company listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (CSU.TO).
Barry Symons has been CEO of Jonas Software since late 2007 (specifically August 2007), and previously served as Chief Financial Officer of Constellation Software from 2004 to 2007.

CORA Group was launched in November 2022 to increase capacity for completing acquisitions and onboarding newly acquired software businesses, and operates over 150 independently managed software brands worldwide.
facts.source_title: Jonas Software Launches CORA Group - Jonas Software

facts.text: 2024 was a record-breaking year for Jonas Software, with 29 innovative software companies acquired, of which 19 were advisor-led processes, bringing total acquisitions to over 175.

On November 4, 2015, Gary Jonas Computing Ltd. and Jonas Computing (UK) Ltd. completed the acquisition of substantially all assets of PAR Springer-Miller Systems from PAR Technology Corporation, expanding Jonas into luxury hotel and hospitality software.
facts.source_title: Constellation Software's Jonas Division Completes Acquisition of PAR Springer-Miller Systems

facts.text: Jonas Software announced the acquisition of Bookassist Holdings Limited on December 13, 2017, a leading provider of booking, digital marketing, and distribution management technology for the hospitality industry.
facts.source_title: Jonas Software Announces the Acquisition of Bookassist Holdings Ltd.

facts.text: Barry Symons holds an Honours Business Degree and a Chartered Accountancy Designation, both received with Distinction. Prior to joining Jonas, he spent 11 years with Constellation Software starting in its infancy, culminating in his role as Chief Financial Officer.
Constellation Software reported organic growth of 2% in 2024, with revenue growth overwhelmingly driven by acquisitions rather than organic expansion in mature vertical market software businesses.
facts.source_title: Constellation Software Inc. Announces Results for Q4 and Year Ended December 31, 2024 - Jonas Software

facts.text: Matt Otchet serves as Group CEO for Foodservice, Construction, Continuing Education, Legal Software & Retail Liquor POS at Jonas Software, and is also the CEO of CORA Group. He joined Jonas through the acquisition of Clubsystems Group in 2005.
facts.source_title: Jonas Software CEO and Key Executive Team | Craft.co

facts.text: Jim Fedigan serves as Group CEO of Jonas Club and Hospitality Divisions, and was promoted to President of Jonas Club Software in 2011. The Club & Hospitality portfolio, originally established in 2003, has acquired 22 independently managed companies and serves 750+ employees.
facts.source_title: Jim Fedigan - Group CEO - Jonas Club and Hospitality Divisions @ Jonas Software - Crunchbase Person Profile

facts.text: Neil Ashizawa serves as Chief Strategy Officer at Jonas Software, bringing experience from previous roles including Chief Product Officer, with expertise in SaaS, Agile Methodologies, Enterprise Software, Cloud Computing, and Go-to-market Strategy.
facts.source_title: Neil Ashizawa - Chief Product Officer @ Jonas Software - Crunchbase Person Profile

facts.text: In 2025, Jonas Software announced 10 strategic acquisitions, bringing its total acquisitions to over 185 independently managed software companies worldwide.
Jonas Fitness commits millions of dollars towards AI development, indicating artificial intelligence is a key focus area within the Jonas Software ecosystem.
facts.source_title: Development Roadmap - Resources - Jonas Fitness, Inc.
